01 / THE IDEATHE LAB, IN BRIEF

A small lab.
A bigger picture.

The best way to understand infrastructure is to build some.

This personal homelab brings physical machines, virtualisation and networking together in one place. It’s a practical environment for exploring how services are hosted, connected and maintained.
